title: Code Autopsy Conservative Test Selection
description: Schema for the deterministic test-selection plan produced by `autopsy test-select` (Phase 4.2 Pillars 2, Steps 33-35). Every field is derived from a reproducible evidence chain: test inventory discovery, observed LCOV coverage, and reverse reachability over the program graph. No probabilistic score appears in this document; the advisory ranking of Step 36 is a separate artifact precisely so that it cannot gate a merge.

selected_tests.description: Concrete test case identifiers to run, sorted. Format `<suite-path>::<kind>::<name>`, or `<suite-path>::<kind>::@line<N>` when the name is computed, or `<suite-path>::@suite` when no cases could be parsed but the suite cannot be ruled out.

selected_suites.description: Repository-relative POSIX paths of the suites to run, sorted.

affected_sources.description: Repository-relative POSIX paths of the source files judged affected, sorted. Computed as the reverse-reachability closure of the change set intersected with the repository file set.

unrulable_out_suites.description: Suites whose mapping is not `verified`, and which were therefore included rather than excluded. This is the load-bearing asymmetry behind the 0%-false-negative gate: a suite the engine could not map is not evidence that it is unaffected. Empty is required for `coverage: verified` to be honest.

fallback.description: What could not be narrowed, and why. A plan with `coverage: unknown` MUST NOT be read as an approval.

packages.description: Top-level directories whose tests must run.

coverage.description: Honesty of the plan as a whole. `verified` requires every selected mapping to be `verified` AND every unselected suite to have been positively ruled out. `unknown` means the plan is not a decision and the fallback governs.

reasons.description: Machine-readable justifications, sorted by code then detail. Always contains a `plan_summary` entry so the narrowing ratio is stated rather than inferred from array lengths.

total_suites.description: Total suites in the inventory, for the "we narrowed X of Y" report.

total_tests.description: Total declared test cases in the inventory.

digest.description: BLAKE3 over the canonical plan body (affected sources, selected tests, fallback kind, coverage state). Wall-clock time and reason prose are deliberately excluded, so the digest is stable across re-runs. 64 lowercase hex characters.
